dialogue.speaker: Gulnara
dialogue.text: Arsen! You look really warm today. What are you wearing?

dialogue.speaker: Arsen
dialogue.text: A thick orange sweater, dark jeans, and my brown leather boots. It's minus six outside — very cold!

dialogue.speaker: Gulnara
dialogue.text: Oh! I only have a thin blue jacket and white trainers. I didn't check the forecast this morning!

dialogue.speaker: Arsen
dialogue.text: Really? That's not enough for today. Your jacket looks quite light and not very warm at all.

dialogue.speaker: Gulnara
dialogue.text: I know — I can feel it now! My hands are absolutely freezing. I should have worn my thick coat.

dialogue.speaker: Arsen
dialogue.text: Here — take my scarf. I have two layers underneath so I'm warm enough without it.

dialogue.speaker: Gulnara
dialogue.text: Are you sure? Thank you so much, Arsen! This scarf is so soft and wonderfully warm!

dialogue.speaker: Arsen
dialogue.text: It's pure wool — my mum bought it at the market in Almaty. Very good quality.

dialogue.speaker: Gulnara
dialogue.text: And your knitted grey hat — it looks really cosy! Does it keep your ears warm?

dialogue.speaker: Arsen
dialogue.text: Completely — it covers my ears entirely. In minus six degrees, that is very important!

dialogue.speaker: Gulnara
dialogue.text: You always dress so practically. Do you check the weather forecast every morning?

dialogue.speaker: Arsen
dialogue.text: Every single morning! I check my forecast app before I even get out of bed.

dialogue.speaker: Gulnara
dialogue.text: I need to do that too. Today was a real lesson — always check the weather before you get dressed!

dialogue.speaker: Arsen
dialogue.text: Exactly! And always keep a warm scarf in your bag. Just in case — you never know!

Arsen's knitted hat is grey and covers his ears completely.
Gulnara decides she will always check the weather forecast before getting dressed.
